desc: A zero-budget film named after a painting bought for €50 off the wall of a restaurant on the Costa Blanca in Spain twenty years ago. A new work of art is created from the painting during the film.
note: Currently screening at festivals – the full film will appear here when the run ends
seo_desc: Le Jazz – a short film by C. M. Taylor (Slow and Spurious Films). Can you make good art from bad?
logline: Can you make good art from bad?
title: Le Jazz
